<!--
  PMS 1.43.3 GET /library/sections/{key}/all — the watched read, and what the server does and does
  NOT honour on it. Recorded 2026-07-30 from a real server (plex-safety rule 11). Titles, ids and
  the section name are sanitized; attribute names, ordering and the container shape are verbatim.

  WHAT WAS MEASURED, on a movie section with 9,897 items of which 1,077 are watched:

    ?type=1                                       -> totalSize=9897   (whole section)
    ?type=1&unwatched=0                           -> totalSize=1077   HONOURED
    ?type=1&unwatched=1                           -> totalSize=8820   HONOURED
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&sort=lastViewedAt:desc    -> totalSize=1077   HONOURED (order verified below)
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&sort=lastViewedAt:asc     -> totalSize=1077   HONOURED

    ?type=1&unwatched=0&lastViewedAt>=<epoch>     -> totalSize=1077   *** IGNORED ***
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&lastViewedAt>>=<epoch>    -> totalSize=1077   *** IGNORED ***
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&viewedAt>>=<epoch>        -> totalSize=1077   *** IGNORED ***
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&year>>=2020  (control)    -> totalSize=1077   *** IGNORED ***
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&lastViewedAt>            -> totalSize=0       parsed, matches nothing
    ?type=1&unwatched=0&lastViewedAt=<epoch>     -> totalSize=0       exact match, useless here

  THE POINT. A cutoff filter on this endpoint is silently ignored: the response is a 200 with the
  FULL set, so an incremental read built on it looks like it worked while saving nothing. The
  `year>>=` control being ignored too shows this is not about `lastViewedAt` — query-param filtering
  simply does not apply on this endpoint as we call it.

  So `PlexClient.watched_titles(..., since=...)` narrows by ORDERING: it sends
  `sort=lastViewedAt:desc` (honoured) and stops at the first title older than the cutoff. That is
  where the saving comes from — one page instead of every page — and it depends only on behaviour
  this server actually has.

  Note the UNSORTED response's `lastViewedAt` values are in no useful order (first five observed:
  1576847797, 1513057169, 1592121344, 1541236133, 1500604279), which is why the sort is required
  rather than merely nice: without it, "stop at the first old one" would stop almost immediately.
-->

     reported totalSize=1077 (see the measurements above) — quoting that here would make a
     single-page replay page forever looking for the other 1074. -->

  <Video ratingKey="10001" key="/library/metadata/10001" guid="plex://movie/REDACTED"
